name: Bit Jarvis
subtitle: Local private agent toolkit
description:
Bit Jarvis is a local-first, privacy-first on-device agent toolkit.

POSITIONING
Utility software: orchestrate tasks on your device, work in a sandbox, and call model APIs you configure (BYOK). It is not a consumer generative-AI content service and does not require a mandatory account.

HIGHLIGHTS
• Multi-persona agents with separate memory
• Local-first storage in the app sandbox
• BYOK or optional gateway models
• On-device tools with OS permission prompts
• Optional E2E IM (can stay off)

PRIVACY
No default analytics, no data selling. Sensitive actions require confirmation. Privacy policy: https://www.bitjarvis.chat/privacy.html

COMPLIANCE
This app is a tool. Model output comes from providers/models you choose. Do not rely on automated output for medical, legal, or financial decisions without human review.

Website: https://www.bitjarvis.chat
Support: bit@bitjarvis.chat
promotionalText: Private on-device agent toolkit. Your keys, your device.
whatsNew: Rebranded to Bit Jarvis, refreshed app icon, clearer privacy/terms entry points, and App Store copy aligned to a utility (non-AIGC-service) positioning.
